name: augur
description: Augur — build/deploy platform composing spaces (design system + prototypes repos) into a static site with an overlay worker.

scripts.deploy: set -a && . ./.env.deploy && set +a && GV_IDENTITY_PATH="${GV_IDENTITY_PATH:-../augur-deploy/identity.json}" GV_DEPLOY_CONFIG_PATH="${GV_DEPLOY_CONFIG_PATH:-../augur-deploy/deploy.config.json}" node build.js && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name "$PAGES_PROJECT" --branch main
scripts.deploy:realtime: set -a && . ./.env.deploy && set +a && cd realtime && npx wrangler deploy
